The DOI is most likely **10.1515/THLI.2008.007**, but I haven't confirmed that it belongs to this exact title. A search found that DOI on a Theoretical Linguistics 2008 PDF, though the page showed no title or abstract ([degruyterbrill.com](https://degruyterbrill.com/document/doi/10.1515/THLI.2008.007/pdf)). Croft & Poole's main MDS article is at [10.1515/THLI.2008.001](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/document/doi/10.1515/THLI.2008.001/html), so .007 is probably a different piece in the same issue, possibly a reply, and the title should be checked on doi.org.

CONFIDENCE: 50
